errors.kube_chat_pod_exited:
kube chat: pod {pod} ended before its exec agent served: container {container} exited {code} ({reason}). Last log lines:
{log}
errors.kube_chat_pod_gone: kube chat: pod {pod} ended before its exec agent served ({reason})
errors.kube_exec_agent_unhealthy: kube chat: pod {pod} exec agent not healthy within {timeout}
errors.no_capacity: every chat slot on this host is taken and none of this workspace's chats can be closed to free one (they are all answering). Try again in a minute.
errors.no_prompt: {agent} can't chat: it has no prompt for the Chat stage (neither prompts/{stage}.md nor prompts/main.md). Add one in Agents → {agent} → Prompts and send the message again.

workspace_at_cap.one: this workspace already has {count} open chat, its plan's limit, and it is answering. Wait for it to finish, or upgrade the plan.
workspace_at_cap.other: this workspace already has {count} open chats, its plan's limit, and all of them are answering. Wait for one to finish, or upgrade the plan.

errors.not_chat_capable: chatruntime: agent type is not chat-capable
errors.not_delegable: chatruntime: only a chat not linked to a task can act for you
errors.not_delegator: chatruntime: this chat acts for another person; only they can write in it
errors.pod_needs_recreate: chatruntime: chat pod must be recreated
errors.turn_in_flight: chatruntime: a turn is already running for this chat

log.container_not_running: {chat} container {container} not running; reaping for recreate
log.delegation_changed: {chat} delegation changed; recreating container {container} with a new key
log.mint_run_key_failed: mint run key for {chat}: {err} — the pod will not be able to fetch its prompts
log.no_api_url: {chat} has no OCTOPUS_API — set OCTOPUS_AGENT_BASE_URL; the pod cannot fetch its prompts
log.no_per_run_browser: {chat} (agent {agent}) is granted thulu-browser on the chat stage but gets no browser: per-run browser mode withholds the shared server, and a Docker chat cannot start its own. Only Kubernetes chats get a per-run browser
log.write_exec_stdin: [chat] write turn text to exec stdin
